title: Spring issue out now
excerpt: The spring issue is out. Read how we will make a difference with the funds raised and how we are giving back to regional communities
body_html:
The spring issue of our bi annual newsletter, Eyecure is now out.

Click here to read about how we will use the funds raised from Last Seen to make a difference and how we are giving back to regional communities. Read about our latest research in Romania and the expanding team in clinical trials.
